newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's SBI index firms on vibrant turnover.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's SBI index firms on vibrant turnover.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI index firmed 0.59 percent on Wednesday on stepped-up turnover but traders see the market consolidating its gains from the recent rally.
"Today's turnover is close to what we can call normal and it's mostly on the back of foreign activity," one broker said.
* The SBI index rose 8.28 points to 1,405.0.
* Turnover rose to 314.4 million tolars from 280.8 million.
* Drug maker Lek had the highest turnover, jumping 3.29 percent to 32,020 tolars on volume of 4,094 shares for total turnover of 129.7 million.
* Brokerage Dadas was the top gainer, surging 10.19 percent to 5,840 tolars on volume of 57 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
